es: Más vale tarde que nunca
say: mahs VAH-leh TAR-deh keh NOON-kah
lit: Better late than never.
en: Better late than never.

es: No hay mal que por bien no venga
say: noh eye mahl keh por byen noh VEN-gah
lit: There's no bad thing that doesn't bring some good.
en: Every cloud has a silver lining.

es: Dime con quién andas y te diré quién eres
say: DEE-meh kohn kyen AHN-dahs ee teh dee-REH kyen EH-rehs
lit: Tell me who you walk with and I'll tell you who you are.
en: You are the company you keep.

es: A caballo regalado no se le mira el diente
say: ah kah-BAH-yoh reh-gah-LAH-doh noh seh leh MEE-rah el DYEN-teh
lit: You don't look at the teeth of a gifted horse.
en: Don't look a gift horse in the mouth.

es: Camarón que se duerme se lo lleva la corriente
say: kah-mah-ROHN keh seh DWER-meh seh loh YEH-vah lah koh-RRYEN-teh
lit: The shrimp that falls asleep gets carried away by the current.
en: You snooze, you lose.

es: Más vale pájaro en mano que cien volando
say: mahs VAH-leh PAH-hah-roh en MAH-noh keh syen voh-LAHN-doh
lit: A bird in the hand is worth more than a hundred flying.
en: A bird in the hand is worth two in the bush.

es: Al mal tiempo, buena cara
say: ahl mahl TYEM-poh, BWEH-nah KAH-rah
lit: To bad weather, a good face.
en: Keep smiling when times are tough.

es: El que mucho abarca poco aprieta
say: el keh MOO-choh ah-BAR-kah POH-koh ah-PRYEH-tah
lit: Whoever embraces too much squeezes little.
en: Don't bite off more than you can chew.

es: En boca cerrada no entran moscas
say: en BOH-kah seh-RRAH-dah noh EN-trahn MOHS-kahs
lit: Flies don't enter a closed mouth.
en: Silence is golden / think before you speak.

es: Ojos que no ven, corazón que no siente
say: OH-hohs keh noh ven, koh-rah-SOHN keh noh SYEN-teh
lit: Eyes that don't see, heart that doesn't feel.
en: What you don't know can't hurt you.

es: Querer es poder
say: keh-RER es poh-DER
lit: To want is to be able.
en: Where there's a will, there's a way.

es: Poco a poco se va lejos
say: POH-koh ah POH-koh seh vah LEH-hohs
lit: Little by little you go far.
en: Slow and steady wins the race.

es: Donde fueres, haz lo que vieres
say: DOHN-deh FWEH-rehs, ahs loh keh VYEH-rehs
lit: Wherever you go, do what you see.
en: When in Rome, do as the Romans do.

es: Perro que ladra no muerde
say: PEH-rroh keh LAH-drah noh MWER-deh
lit: A dog that barks doesn't bite.
en: His bark is worse than his bite.

es: No dejes para mañana lo que puedes hacer hoy
say: noh DEH-hehs PAH-rah mah-NYAH-nah loh keh PWEH-dehs ah-SER oy
lit: Don't leave for tomorrow what you can do today.
en: Don't put off till tomorrow what you can do today.

es: El tiempo es oro
say: el TYEM-poh es OH-roh
lit: Time is gold.
en: Time is money.

es: Cada loco con su tema
say: KAH-dah LOH-koh kohn soo TEH-mah
lit: Every crazy person with their own topic.
en: To each their own.

es: Más sabe el diablo por viejo que por diablo
say: mahs SAH-beh el DYAH-bloh por VYEH-hoh keh por DYAH-bloh
lit: The devil knows more from being old than from being the devil.
en: Experience is the best teacher.

es: A mal paso, darle prisa
say: ah mahl PAH-soh, DAR-leh PREE-sah
lit: Through a bad step, hurry.
en: If it's unpleasant, get it over with quickly.

es: Al que madruga, Dios lo ayuda
say: ahl keh mah-DROO-gah, dyohs loh ah-YOO-dah
lit: God helps whoever gets up early.
en: The early bird catches the worm.

es: Del dicho al hecho hay mucho trecho
say: del DEE-choh ahl EH-choh eye MOO-choh TREH-choh
lit: From saying to doing there's a long stretch.
en: Easier said than done.

es: Entre broma y broma, la verdad se asoma
say: EN-treh BROH-mah ee BROH-mah, lah ver-DAHD seh ah-SOH-mah
lit: Between joke and joke, the truth peeks out.
en: Many a true word is spoken in jest.
